author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m wearing the Blaklader Solano ventilated work pants. I like the zippered vents and side pockets for pencils, utility knives, keys, and work booties. Plus these are great pants for grabbing a beer and dinner, lots of versatility on and off the job.
